verdict.rationale: Missive ships its own in-product AI assistant that can compose, reply and translate, create drafts, run assistant sessions, and reach proprietary data through custom MCP. This gives users AI suggestions inside the product, but the evidence never shows the assistant producing insights or summaries from the user's own inbox data inside Missive; inbox summarization is shown only for external Claude via MCP. The assistant also requires the user's own Anthropic, OpenAI or Gemini API key. Missing for 10: documented in-product insights or summaries over the user's conversations and data, depth of suggestion features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Quickly compose, reply, and translate messages with AI directly in Missive.
With custom MCP, you can connect any MCP-compatible server to Missive's AI Copilot and let AI interact with your internal systems, proprietary data, or homegrown tools.
Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server, now resolve {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} from your organization profile
The assistant runs on your own API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google Gemini.
